title: Your Home Screen
summary: How the main Iron Rabbit screen works and where to start.

cards.heading: What this screen does
cards.body: This is the heart of Iron Rabbit. Every note, chore, list, and reminder lives here. Notes live on your phone — nothing is uploaded.

cards.heading: Creating your first note
cards.body: Tap the lightning icon at the top to open Quick Add. Pick any icon and Iron Rabbit builds a matching note for you — no typing needed.

cards.heading: Switching how notes look
cards.body: Tap the layout toggle to the right of the search bar. Choose compact rows for scanning fast, or icon tiles when you want colour and delight.

cards.heading: Tip: Long-press to reorder
cards.body: Tip: Long-press any note and drag it. Your notes stay in the order that makes sense to you — not the app.

cards.heading: Related features
cards.body: Tap the shopping cart for Shopping Mode. Tap the chef hat for Meal Planner. Tap the settings gear for Quick Guides and backups.
